SEN.note: Nothing on the central bank's role.

facts.fact: The executive secretary of Senegal's Observatoire de la Qualité des Services Financiers (OQSF) writes that mobile money users can seek redress from a third party such as the OQSF when a provider does not resolve a problem; in its 2022 survey with CGAP only 1% did.

systems.system: OQSF (Observatoire de la Qualité des Services Financiers)

SEN.note: Nothing on government payments to people.
The survey covers mobile money users only, not adults.

facts.fact: An OQSF-CGAP survey of 1,517 mobile money users in September-October 2022 found 98% had used digital financial services in the past 30 days, for deposits, withdrawals, transfers, bill and merchant payments.
